title: Now Showing
description: Cinema app with movie posters over a blurred backdrop that cross-fades with progress.
steps: `itemSize` is 1.05 × the poster width, and `itemAnimation` scales neighbors to 0.84, sinks them 24 pt per 220 pt of poster and fades them to 0.6.
Every movie has a full-screen backdrop layer whose opacity is 1 minus its distance to `progress` on the loop, so two backdrops cross-fade while you drag.
The same `progress` blends the button between the two accents with `interpolateColor`, and the details switch as soon as another poster is the nearest.
